clauses.text: the Network page of Settings shows the Ethernet and WiFi rows (read only)

steps.do: Open Settings, Network. Switch Ethernet off and on, then WiFi off and on.
steps.expect: Each row shows its state, address and speed while on, and not found when no adapter is present.
steps.runner_did: Checked the page text first (when run through the runner)
